strands.strand_title: STUDY OF THE QURAN AND HADITH

sub_strands.title: Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an
learning_outcomes: a) analyse the circumstances that led to compilation of the Qur’an during the reign of caliph Abubakar (R.A.)
b) examine the circumstances that led to standardisation of the Qur’an during the reign of caliph Uthman (R.A.)
c) describe the process of compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an during the reigns of caliphs Abubakar (R.A.) and Uthman (R.A.)
d) explain the significance of compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an as ways of preserving it
e) apply the qualities of the compilers of the Qur’an in daily life
f) appreciate the process of compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an as a means of preserving Islamic heritage.
learning_experiences: research online or from available reference materials on the circumstances of compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an during the reigns of caliphs Abubakar (R.A.) and Uthman (R.A.) and present in class
discuss on the process of compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an during the reigns of caliphs Abubakar (R.A.) and Uthman (R.A.) in groups and present in class
brainstorm in groups on the significance of compiling the Qur’an and write notes
demonstrate the qualities of the compilers of the Qur’an (trustworthiness, record keeping, team work, integrity, leadership).
key_inquiry_questions: What are the benefits of compilation of the Qur’an?

sub_strands.title: Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an
learning_outcomes: a) examine the circumstances that led to diacriticalisation of the Qur’an for correct recitation
b) assess the significance of diacriticalisation of the Qur’an for ease of reading
c) read the Qur’an with correct articulation
d) acknowledge the process of diacriticalisation of the Qur’an as a way of perfecting recitation.
learning_experiences: research online or from available reference materials the circumstances that led to diacriticalisation of the Qur’an (vowelling marks – tashkil and diacritical marks- i’jam) and present in class
brainstorm on the significance of diacriticalisation of the Qur’an, prepare a chart and present in class
prepare a chart with Qur’an verses with diacritical marks and corresponding verses without and display in class
read Qur’an verses with diacritical marks and corresponding verses without them.
key_inquiry_questions: Why is diacriticalisation of the Qur’an important?

sub_strands.title: Foods and Drinks
learning_outcomes: a) examine the rationale for the prohibition of certain foods and drinks (carrion, blood, pork, animals dedicated to other than Allah (S.W.T.) for maintenance of good health,
b) explain the benefits of adopting healthy eating habits as a way of preventing lifestyle diseases,
c) describe the etiquette of slaughtering as a way of upholding the sunnah,
d) adopt healthy eating habits in day-to-day life.
learning_experiences: identify the prohibited foods and drinks in their locality in groups and present in class,
brainstorm on the rationale for the prohibition of certain foods and drinks and make class presentation,
search online or on available reference materials the prohibited foods and drinks and make notes,
watch a video of a resource person giving a talk on the effects of prohibited foods and unhealthy eating habits and make notes,
discuss the benefits of good eating habits in groups and present in class,
collect pictures on prohibited foods and drinks, make charts and display,
search online and watch a video clip on the Islamic etiquette of slaughtering and make class presentations,
brainstorm on the measures to be adopted in promoting healthy eating habits and make charts and display.
key_inquiry_questions: 1. Why should Muslims observe the etiquette of slaughtering animals?
2. What are the benefits of eating healthy?

sub_strands.title: Virtues: Islamic clothing and adornment
learning_outcomes: a) explain the rules and regulations governing clothing and adornment in Islam,
b) assess the rationale for the Islamic code of dressing and adornment as a basis for safeguarding modesty,
c) practise the Islamic code of dressing and adornment in day-to-day life,
d) appreciate the Islamic code of dress as an act of ibaadah.
learning_experiences: search online or on available reference materials the rules and regulations governing clothing and adornment (tattooing, beautification surgery, wigs) in Islam and present in class,
distinguish between male and female code of dressing and adornment, make charts and display,
brainstorm on the purpose of clothing and adornment in Islam and make notes,
Search online or on available reference materials the rationale for the Islamic code of dressing and make class presentation,
model Islamic clothing and adornment take pictures and put in portfolio,
draw/cut out different types of Islamic dress and display.
key_inquiry_questions: 1. Why should a Muslim observe the Islamic clothing and adornment?
2. How can the Muslim youth promote Islamic identity through dress?

sub_strands.title: Muslim Dynasties
learning_outcomes: a) explain the factors that led to the rise of the Umayyad Dynasty for correct understanding of Islamic history,
b) assess the contributions of Muawiya ibn Abu Sufyan, Abdulmalik ibn Marwan and, Umar ibn Abdulaziz to the development of Islam,
c) examine the achievements of the Umayyad Dynasty,
d) describe factors that led to the decline of the Umayyad Dynasty,
e) appreciate the role played by the Umayyad Dynasty in the development of Islamic heritage.
learning_experiences: search online or from available reference materials on the factors that led to the spread to the rise of the Umayyad Dynasty and make notes,
search online or from available reference materials the contributions of Muawiya ibn Abu Sufyan, Abdulmalik ibn Marwan, Umar ibn Abdulaziz and make class/power point presentation,
brainstorm on the achievements of the Umayyad Dynasty and present in class,
search online for maps of the territorial rule of, draw on a chart a Umayyad Dynasty and display in class,
discuss the factors that led to the decline of the Umayyad Dynasty in group and make notes.
key_inquiry_questions: What are the achievements of Umayyad Dynasty?

sub_strands.title: Islam in Tanzania and Uganda
learning_outcomes: a) explain the factors that led to the spread of Islam in Tanzania and Uganda up to the 19th century,
b) assess the social, political and economic impacts of Islam in Tanzania and Uganda,
c) examine the challenges facing Muslims in Tanzania and Uganda in the 21st century,
d) propose possible solutions to the challenges facing Muslims in Tanzania and Uganda,
e) appreciate the role of Islam in Africa as a heritage.
learning_experiences: search online or on available reference materials the factors that led to the spread of Islam in Tanzania and Uganda up to the 19th century and make notes,
brainstorm on the social, political and economic impacts of Islam in Tanzania and Uganda and present in class,
research on the challenges facing Muslims Tanzania and Uganda in the 21st century and make summary notes,
discuss possible solutions to address the challenges facing Muslims in Africa (social, political and economic) in groups, make charts and display in class,
search online or on available reference materials for demographic maps in Tanzania, Uganda, on Muslims, make summary notes and present in class.
key_inquiry_questions: 1. What challenges are Muslims facing in East Africa?
2. What are the possible solutions to the challenges Muslims face in East Africa?
